# Virtual network link

One virtual network link of a DNS forwarding ruleset
(`Microsoft.Network/dnsForwardingRulesets/virtualNetworkLinks`): the linked virtual network's DNS
queries follow the ruleset's rules. `modules/forwarding_ruleset` calls it once per link; a spoke can call
it alone from its own state with the ruleset's resource ID.

Azure cannot point a link at another virtual network, so changing `virtual_network_id` replaces it.

Removing one metadata entry leaves the other keys as they were, and azapi compares only the keys in the
body, so the metadata is also sent through `sensitive_body`, versioned by a hash of the map: any change,
a removed entry included, plans an update that writes it.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the virtual network link. Changing it replaces the link.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the DNS forwarding ruleset that holds the link.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_virtual_network_id"></a> [virtual\_network\_id](#input\_virtual\_network\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the virtual network whose DNS queries the ruleset's rules apply to, in the ruleset's region and tenant (any subscription). Do not link the virtual network of an inbound endpoint that a rule in the ruleset forwards to: its queries would loop. Changing it replaces the link.

Type: `string`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_lock_dependency"></a> [lock\_dependency](#output\_lock\_dependency)

Description: Changes whenever the link is created, replaced or changed. The caller passes it in the ruleset's `lock_dependencies`: Azure applies the ruleset's lock to the link too, and a `ReadOnly` lock also blocks updating it in place, which keeps its ID.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: Name of the virtual network link.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the virtual network link.
